TV Actor Rohit Chandel Arrested Under POCSO Act

Television actor Rohit Chandel has been arrested and booked under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, along with other provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). The charges relate to allegations of molesting and stalking a minor. The arrest has drawn attention to the actor's identity and the legal proceedings against him.
